description.value:
You've mastered meditative techniques that quiet your mind. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

A long rest only requires 3 hours of sleep for you to gain its benefits, rather than 6, and an interrupted long rest need only be completed — rather than restarted — for you to still gain its benefits.

You have advantage on saving throws against psychic damage.
